columns.name: show_id
columns.description: One settlement per show. A new review reuses this row rather than creating a second one.

columns.name: recoupable_total_cents
columns.description: Sum of recoupable expenses before the deal cap.

columns.name: recoup_cap_cents
columns.description: Cap snapshot from the show, so a later deal edit cannot change a settled payout.

columns.name: over_cap_cents
columns.description: Recoupable expense the house absorbs because it exceeds the cap.

columns.name: pool_cents
columns.description: Net box office minus recouped expense. Never below zero.

columns.name: calculated_payout_cents
columns.description: Deterministic result of the deal formula. The agent never changes this number.

columns.name: approved_payout_cents
columns.description: What the manager approved. May differ from the calculated amount only with a written note.

columns.name: agent_review
columns.description: The settlement-reviewer snapshot: headline, recommendation, findings, confidence.

columns.name: approved_by
columns.description: Email of the person who answered the approval form. Cleared when a settlement is reopened.
